verdict.rationale: A high-yield savings sub-account with automated transfer rules is a fair question for a business account product, so the axis applies. The evidence covers multi-currency balances ([wise-docs-25]) and opt-in passthrough FDIC insurance ([wise-docs-11]), but nothing about interest or yield, savings sub-accounts, or rule-based automatic transfers. Those items are adjacent features and earn no credit.
